tools.name: mcs150_lookup
tools.description: Use this when you need to know whether a US motor carrier's biennial MCS-150 update is due or overdue. For 1 to 10 USDOT numbers: next and last filing deadline (49 CFR 390.19T), days left in the carrier's state time zone, overdue flag, USDOT status, and deactivation enforcement: the FMCSA suspended

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "mcs150_lookup" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
